property_summary: After Initialized() is called, calling SetLogFile(address) must revert (reference) due to the initialization guard, but the mutant removes that guard and thus allows SetLogFile to succeed for some inputs, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace the body of SetLogFile so it assigns the provided address to LogFile without the initialization guard (remove the revert check), allowing SetLogFile to change LogFile even after initialized is true.
